newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real dips 0.03 pct in calm trading.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real dips 0.03 pct in calm trading.

text.p: Brazil's real dipped 0.03 percent to close at 1.0707 per dollar in calm trading on the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
Players expect a decline in the reais-dollar mini-band in coming days. The current mini-band was set on Friday by the Central Bank at between 1.0700 and 1.0750 reais per dollar.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed unchanged at 1.0756 per greenback.
In the parallel market, the real ended flat at 1.130 per dollar, traders said.
